logo.description: The logo of the organization, file type must be png or jpeg.

data.description:
A JSON string that contains the details to update. Every key is optional; only the keys you send are changed.

- `organization_name` (string): the new name of the organization, up to 64 characters.
- `timezone_utc_offset` (string): the new timezone offset of the organization.
- `is_approval_required` (boolean): whether the approval workflow is enabled or not.
- `is_link_shortener_enabled` (boolean): whether registration links sent to receivers are shortened.
- `is_memo_tracing_enabled` (boolean): whether payments carry a tracing memo.
- `receiver_registration_message_template` (string): the message template sent to the receivers inviting them to registration. Up to 255 characters, and it cannot contain HTML, JS or CSS. Sending this field empty sets the `default` value for it.
- `otp_message_template` (string): the message template sent to the receivers sending the OTP to complete the registration flow. Sending this field empty sets the `default` value for it.
- `privacy_policy_link` (string): a URL to the organization privacy policy. Sending it empty clears it.
- `webhook_url` (string): an https URL the SDP delivers outbox events to. Owner only; sending it empty clears it.
- `receiver_invitation_resend_interval_days` (number): how often an unregistered receiver is re-invited. Sending 0 clears it.
- `payment_cancellation_period_days` (number): how long a READY payment waits before it is canceled automatically. Sending 0 clears it.
- `mfa_disabled` (boolean): whether multi-factor authentication is turned off for dashboard sign-in.
- `captcha_disabled` (boolean): whether reCAPTCHA is turned off.
- `receiver_invitations_disabled` (boolean): whether receiver invitation messages are suppressed.

For example:

`{"organization_name": "NewOrgName", "timezone_utc_offset": "+02:00", "is_approval_required": true, "receiver_registration_message_template": "You have a payment waiting for you from {{.OrganizationName}}. Click {{.RegistrationLink}} to register.", "otp_message_template": "{{.OTP}} is your {{.OrganizationName}} phone verification code."}`
